metadata.description: Development workflow plugins by Subverting Complexity: one for GitHub-backed work, one for work that stays on your machine.

plugins.name: github-workflow
plugins.description: Takes a GitHub story end to end: picks it off the backlog, plans, builds, runs the quality gate, opens a pull request, has that pull request reviewed by agents in a fresh context, and merges it where auto-merge is enabled. Every decision reads structured GitHub state — Stage, Priority, Effort and Ownership are org issue fields — so no label, no board card and no line of an issue body changes what gets picked. The state lives on the issue, so nothing has to be on a board to be picked up, and every board grouped by Stage shows the same answer. It reads the Epic and Feature tree too: a bulk run can take its set from the stories under one Epic or Feature, and an Epic or Feature is closed once its last sub-issue closes. Every interview, from stress-testing a plan to scoping a feature, runs through one shared `grill` skill, which leads each question with a recommendation and never guesses an answer when nobody is there to give it.

plugins.name: local-workflow
plugins.description: Plans, writes, verifies and commits a task on your machine. No issue tracker, no pull request and no platform to configure, plus architecture design and audit, feature discovery, a shared `grill` interview that stress-tests plans, debugging, security audit, user stories, PR descriptions, documentation and tone-matched correspondence.
